title: Privacy notice
description: A working privacy draft for the pre-launch Impact Sol website and its enquiry forms.
body: This is a working draft and requires owner and legal review before public launch. The website may collect the name, contact details, organisation details and message that a person chooses to submit through an enquiry form, together with limited technical information needed to protect the form from abuse. The intended purposes are to acknowledge the enquiry, route it to the appropriate recipient, respond where appropriate and maintain service security. Access should be restricted to authorised people, and records should be retained only for an approved period before secure deletion. No non-essential analytics or advertising technology is intended at launch. Requests about access, correction or deletion may be sent through the published contact route. Before publication, the owner must confirm the responsible legal entity, lawful bases, processors, international transfers, retention periods, jurisdiction-specific rights and the monitored privacy contact.
